text:
rita_dev: Heads-up — onboarding sample app shows swapped/missing vectors from batched embeddings+rerank when a token refresh happens mid-flight. Node (1.0.0-beta) and Go (v0.7.1) both hit it; Python SDK is fine.

ken_sdk: Can you paste the exact request/response that repros it? Also: using the sampleapp batcher or a custom batching helper?

rita_dev: Using sampleapp batcher with default settings. Minimal repro (I forced token expiry before sending):
```json
POST /v1/embeddings/batch
Authorization: Bearer <expiring-token>
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "open-vec-2",
  "inputs": ["a", "b"]
}
```
Flaky response we saw: 
```json
{
  "results": [
    { "id": "1", "embedding": [0.01, -0.2, ...] },
    null
  ]
}
```
Sometimes the second entry was an empty array instead of null. No error returned.

ian_infra: This lines up with a race in the auth retry wrapper: when refresh is triggered, the wrapper can replay only the tail of a batch. Server accepts fragments and merges, but the sampleapp zipper expects positional alignment and inserts placeholders for missing slots. The result is null/empty vector entries or misordered items.

ken_sdk: Quick mitigation we shipped in my local patch: annotate each input with a stable `_batch_id` (nanoid) and have the server echo `_batch_id` in results; the client remaps by `_batch_id` not by array index. That removes index-sensitivity. I pushed a small PR to sdk-node: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/sdk-node/pulls/1310 (draft).

anya_docs: Nice. For customers, add an env flag `BATCHER_MAP_BY_ID=true` to toggle the safe behaviour in sampleapp until SDKs land. I'll update onboarding checklist and note the behaviour under "Batching and retries".

rita_dev: Confirmed: enabling map-by-id removed nulls in 5k runs locally while forcing token refresh. Repro rate dropped from ~28% to 0%.

ian_infra: Longer-term we should also: 1) make auth refresh single-flight so callers block until new token rather than racing; 2) change retry wrapper to replay full batch instead of fragments; 3) add server-side validation that fragments include `_batch_id`s or else reject merge. I'll open INFRA-903.

ken_sdk: One more nuance: embeddings endpoint uses `embedding` field, rerank uses `vec`. SDKs assume a single canonical field and our mismatch contributed to mapping bugs. Recommend docs update and an API consistency RFC.

anya_docs: Filed DOCS-527: "Batching, retries, and response-field parity (embedding vs vec)". Will add sample snippets for both endpoints and a short troubleshooting section: "If you see null or empty vectors in batched responses, enable BATCHER_MAP_BY_ID and file a ticket."

ops-bot: CI note — integration test added to sampleapp pipeline: simulate auth refresh mid-batch and assert no nulls when BATCHER_MAP_BY_ID=true. Job queued.

rita_dev: Thanks — leaving follow-ups on the PRs and infra ticket. Ping me if CI still shows flakes. :rocket:
